brief.t: START HERE: Call Sam and Ron to name Talova’s safety approver and confirm the authorized recovery method.

ACT NOW 1: Talova safe recovery remains unverified. Splash reported November 3, 8 days ago. No later safe-method approval, accepted trial evidence or suspect-unit disposition was found in the bounded review. Send internally: Sam, Ron and Aaron, please name the approver and record the safe recovery method, trial results and suspect-unit disposition today before affected-method reuse or a completion promise.

ACT NOW 2: Roon November 18 start needs a material and sanitation checkpoint. Evelyn’s inventory report yesterday flags nine shortages, plus uncertain gross-weight stock and an unfilled microsilica stock field. The inspected sheet totals 188 kg, while the body cites a 10,200-unit planning allowance. Gattefosse received a PO but needs address confirmation; Estogel payment confirmation was sent, not applied/ship proof. Ecolab asks about November 20 versus the projected November 18 start; sanitation, capper trial and usable materials are not released. Send internally: Michael, Evelyn and Aaron, please reconcile released stock and existing orders against the approved Roon quantity today, name each shortage’s owner and ETA, and confirm the sanitation and capper-trial gates before reaffirming November 18.

ACT NOW 3: Lice Sisters preservative conflict remains unresolved. Evelyn’s November 9 request is 2 days old: 1.2 kg in 120 kg implies 1%. The historical Repel sheet also lists 1%, versus the named supplier’s suggested 0.1–0.5%. This is an unresolved formula/specification conflict, not proof of an executed nonconforming batch and not authority to choose a replacement dose. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, please reconcile the exact preservative, current approved formula and supplier use limits today before purchase or addition; keep the 2–3 kg buying buffer separate from batch dosage.

next: Recommendation: Close the safety and preservative decisions, and obtain a dated Roon readiness checkpoint before repeating production dates.
